name: Quarto (Declarative)
description: Quarto on a 4x4 board: you never choose your own piece - you place the piece your opponent handed you, then choose which piece to hand them next. Complete a line of four pieces sharing one attribute to win.

strings.title: Quarto
strings.pool: Pool - tap a piece to give
strings.hint_give: Choose a piece for your opponent
strings.hint_cell: Tap a cell to place your piece
strings.hint_next: Now tap a pool piece to hand over

rules: Quarto for 2 players on a 4x4 board with 16 unique pieces. Each piece combines tall or short, light or dark, round or square, and solid or hollow; piece id 0-15 is the 4-bit attribute vector (bit0: 1=tall, bit1: 1=dark, bit2: 1=square, bit3: 1=hollow). You never choose your own piece: seat 0 opens with a give-only move {type:"give", piece} that hands a pool piece to seat 1. Every later turn is one combined move {type:"turn", cell, give}: place the piece in your hand on an empty cell, then choose an unplayed pool piece to hand to your opponent. give is required unless the placement ends the game or the pool is empty (the final placement), when give must be null. After a placement, any row, column or main diagonal whose four pieces share at least one attribute value (all tall, all short, all light, all dark, all round, all square, all solid or all hollow) wins immediately for the player who placed. The winner takes the pot. If all 16 pieces are placed with no winning line, the game is a draw and the pot is split equally. Illegal moves (occupied cell, giving a played or in-hand piece, giving on the final move, or acting in the wrong phase) are rejected. All state is public.
ui_instructions: 4x4 board on top; below it the piece in hand (large) and the pool of unplayed pieces. Pieces are legible at a glance: round or square shape, tall pieces are larger than short ones, dark pieces are brown and light pieces cream, and each label repeats height and top - T or s for tall/short plus a filled dot for solid or an open circle for hollow (for example T with a filled dot is tall and solid). On the opening move, tap a pool piece to hand it to your opponent. On your turn, tap an empty cell, then tap a pool piece to hand over; if the placement wins or is the last piece, use the Place and finish button instead. Only the player to move sees targets and controls.

tutorial.text: Place the piece your opponent chose for you, then choose the piece they must place next. Four in a row, column or diagonal that share any one attribute - all tall, all dark, all round, all solid, and so on - wins.

es.short_description: Quarto en un tablero 4x4: nunca eliges tu propia pieza; colocas la que te dio tu rival y luego eliges la que le entregas. Completa una línea de cuatro piezas con un atributo común para ganar.
es.game_logic_rules: Quarto en un tablero 4x4: nunca eliges tu propia pieza; colocas la que te dio tu rival y luego eliges la que le entregas. Completa una línea de cuatro piezas con un atributo común para ganar.
es.game_ui_rules: Tablero 4x4 arriba; abajo, la pieza en mano (grande) y el resto de piezas. Forma, tamaño, color y etiqueta (T/s y punto lleno o círculo vacío) distinguen cada pieza. Toca una casilla y luego una pieza del resto; si la jugada gana o es la última, usa el botón de terminar.

tutorial_strings.Place the piece your opponent chose for: Coloca la pieza que tu rival eligió para ti y luego elige la que deberá colocar. Cuatro en fila, columna o diagonal que compartan un atributo ganan.
